Vegetable - Cheese Bake
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:12pm

Ingredients




1 lg. bunch broccoli or head cauliflower or 2 (10 o
cooked
drained
1 can cream of celery, chicken
1/2 cup milk
1/2 cup sharp cheddar, shredded
1/4 cup buttered bread crumbs

Preparation

1 Place broccoli or cauliflower in shallow baking dish (10 x 6 x 2 inches). Blend soup, milk and cheese; pour over vegetables. Top with crumbs. Bake in 350 degree oven for 30 minutes or until bubbling.
